front.title: External Authorization and Bounded CLOCKOUT for Agentic Systems

abstract.t:
Agentic systems can continue proposing work after authorization changes, while delegated credentials, queued jobs, and operations already in flight may continue producing effects. This document specifies a proposed operational profile that separates agent proposals from authoritative authorization, effect admission, computation termination, and bounded closure. It defines enforcement assumptions, revocation barriers, descendant handling, status evidence, and fault tests. The profile complements existing authorization and revocation mechanisms. It does not define a new token format, establish closure outside declared coverage, reverse committed effects, or infer an agent's mental state.
